purpose: Evaluate one fixed and two queue-adaptive Hiku/Jiagu Borda NSESche profiles against all nine unchanged baselines on the same untouched E380-E389 tapes, eliminating the cross-cohort threshold problem before any selection.

scientific_correction.problem: Frozen E01-E10 absolute thresholds are not exchangeable with later random-DAG cohorts; V65 and V66 demonstrated large cohort shifts under an unchanged mechanism.
scientific_correction.solution: Run all nine frozen baseline implementations and all three NSESche candidates on exactly the same fresh tape for every seed, then compare paired cohort means.

mechanism.definition: At low current pending-plus-runnable tasks per node, give the frozen Jiagu current-demand ordinal rank two votes and Hiku one; at or above a fixed density threshold, give Hiku two votes and Jiagu one.
mechanism.threshold_source: Both boundaries were preregistered before V69 in the fixed Jiagu/Hiku router family; no E380-E409 input or outcome existed when this plan was written.

candidates.definition: Frozen V69 throughput-leading one-Hiku/two-Jiagu Borda profile.

result_blind_execution_order: Commit this plan before generating any E380-E389 run spec or tape.
Build and hash-bind one 90-run baseline manifest and three ten-run NSESche manifests.
Capture ten fresh base tapes once and derive ten scale5 tapes; bind identical tape hashes to all twelve policies for each seed.
Bind the already frozen FaaSRank model without retraining or selection.
Build all thirty candidate-specific references with attempt-one and zero-quarantine gates before any online run.
Run all 120 processes strictly serially; require exact joint coverage, attempt-one QC, zero quarantine, pairing, tape and runtime identity.
Read throughput and QPR exactly once only after the complete joint audit passes.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across all ten paired seeds.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run throughput/(latency*cost) across finite runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: Same QPR with zero-completion runs contributing zero over all ten seeds.
analysis.baseline_threshold_per_metric: Maximum arithmetic mean among the nine unchanged paired baselines.
analysis.candidate_gate: Strictly exceed the strongest paired baseline mean for throughput, finite-only QPR and zero-as-zero QPR; ties fail.
analysis.selection_rule: Among passing candidates, maximize the minimum relative margin over the three paired baseline thresholds; exact ties follow listed candidate order.
analysis.uncertainty: Also report paired per-seed differences and BCa confidence intervals without using them to relax the strict mean gate.
analysis.success_action: Freeze one profile and preregister E390-E409 n20 confirmation with all nine baselines on shared fresh tapes before generating those seeds.
analysis.failure_action: Retain every E380-E389 artifact and preregister a new NSESche-only mechanism on seeds at or after E410.
